mechanism: Retained diagnostic candidate: A and B crates with an arbitrary keyed profile; execution uses exact string identity, stops B before the plate, then permits B after fresh review. Busy controls are now disabled. This candidate is not recommended for publication.
spatialBenefit: No sufficient benefit established; the profile conceals an equality check, and clearance is not exact identity.
beyondVideoTest: Omit. Exact (artifact,target) approval needs two independent equality checks. A four-cell matrix shows A/staging, A/production, B/staging and B/production simultaneously without perspective occlusion. Recasting those checks as physical interlocks creates arbitrary geometry and still adds no useful spatial relation beyond the guide/video. No replacement GLB is claimed.

pickTargets: Gate or approval plate moves the camera to production, looking back through the gate
interaction.motion: Crate moves take 0.6 to 2.1 seconds; the plate recut takes about 0.7 seconds. Reduced motion jumps to end states. Nothing moves before an action.

expectedObservations: A passes the gate and reaches production.
After the swap, B stops in front of the gate with its deep teeth against the plate’s tall notches; nothing deploys.
After “Review B”, the plate notches change height to B’s profile and B passes.
sourceGuide: content/concepts/human-in-the-loop.json (example: approval of A is not approval of B; walkthrough steps 3 and 4)
limitations: The keel stands for an immutable artifact digest plus target; the target is not shown separately.
Pause and resume durability, duplicate resumption and rejection paths from the guide are not depicted.
The plate recut is an animation of recording a new decision; it does not show the authenticated reviewer or where the decision is stored.
Teeth differences are clearest from low and end-on angles; from the default overview they are visible but subtle.
One-sided clearance does not faithfully encode exact identity; deliberately not cosmetically repaired because the candidate is omitted.
Old framing and gate-pick keyboard limitations remain in this unpublished candidate.
revisionProvenance: Original candidate authored under the requested Opus label; this revision executed by GPT-6-based Codex after a model switch. authorModel retained as explicitly requested, not a claim that Opus executed the revision.
